verdict.rationale: React itself doesn't ship a dev server/build tool (that role is filled by Vite/Next.js/etc.), but React Compiler docs describe distinguishing build-time compiler errors from runtime issues, and the editor-setup docs recommend eslint-plugin-react-hooks to catch bugs early, which are relevant error-feedback mechanisms tied to React's own tooling. missing for 10: dedicated dev-server error overlay/documentation, first-party build-tool error message examples, independent hands-on evidence of error message clarity/quality.
